sn23.9:1.2: nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantam Rādham Bhagavā etad avoca || || 4
sn23.9:1.3: Rūpe kho Rādha yo chande yo rāgo yā nandi yā taṇhā tam pajahatha || ||
sn23.9:1.4: evaṃ taṃ rūpam pahīnam bhavissati ucchinnamūlaṃ tālāvatthukataṃ anabhāvakatam āyatim anuppādadhammaṃ || || 5
sn23.9:1.5: Vedanāya yo chando yo rāgo yā nandi yā taṇhā tam pajahatha ||
sn23.9:1.6: evaṃ sā vedanā pahīnā bhavissati ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvakatā āyatim anuppādadhammā || || 6-7
sn23.9:1.8: Saṅkhāresu yo chando yo rāgo yā nandi yā taṇhā taṃ pajahatha ||
sn23.9:1.9: evante saṅkhārā pahīnā bhavissanti ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvakatā āyatim anuppādadhammā || || 8
sn23.9:1.10: Viññāṇe yo chando yo rāgo yā nandi yā taṇhā tam pajahatha ||
sn23.9:1.11: evaṃ taṃ viññāṇam bhavissati || pa || dhamman ti || || 1-3 Sāvatthi || ||
